messages.subject: How do I make sense of impossible r-square values in Lavaan?
parts:
Our model returned:

R-Square:

    autos_per_hh   -197.955
    vmt_per_hh        0.910
    median_smoc_mortgage     0.597
    pct_transit_commuters     0.370

I assume that there is a problem in our model, but curious why that would result in such an R-Square?

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: How do I make sense of impossible r-square values in Lavaan?
parts:
Gregory--
     Is this a nonrecursive model--maybe a model with reciprocal relations? the usual definition of R2 does not make the same sense for nonrecursive models.
     If your model is recursive (no loops), then my best guess would be a marginal identification problem, where model parameters are nearly not identified--not a total identification failure, but enough to produce strange values for one or more of the components of the R2 formula.
--Ed Rigdon

Sent from my iPad
